blocking_items.requirement: 0787 check 1: one guarded read per file per snapshot; A226 item 1 single-read rule.
blocking_items.finding: snapshot groups by realpath, not descriptor (dev, ino). Two hard-link paths to one regular file each call read_once, read the same inode twice, and return exit 0. OneRead.get has the same realpath-only cache for collect.
blocking_items.reproduction: OWN_CHECKS.json and own_checks_cx1.py: synthetic input.txt and alias.txt have equal dev/ino; each bytes_read=6; snapshot exit=0. No production input was mutated.
blocking_items.scope: A contract violation, not demonstrated acceptance of unhashed bytes. Both observations are hashed correctly; no scientific result is implicated.
blocking_items.requested_fix: Use file identity to share a single content-read result across aliases, while retaining each path resolution and checking descriptor identity safely; alternatively refuse duplicate inode aliases before a second content read. Add hard-link regressions for snapshot and collect, with independent content-read counts. Publish an immutable successor.
